panel.empty_state:
No contacts configured yet.
Click the + button above to add one.
panel.error_saving: Could not save the contact list. Check the log.
panel.invalid_contact: Type a name and a sound path first.
panel.stop_tooltip: Stop the sound that is currently playing
panel.title: Contact Sounds
panel.need_sounds: The folder must contain an audio file (.ogg, .mp3 or .wav).

contact_images.description: Map of names to a photo or icon file path shown in the panel list. App entries fall back to the app's own icon when empty.
contact_images.label: Photo / icon per entry

contact_kinds.description: Entry type. 'contact' / 'group' match notification text, 'app' matches the notification app name only.
contact_kinds.label: Types (Contact / Group / App)

contacts.description: Map of person/group/app names to the sound played when a notification mentions them. Value: absolute path to a .ogg/.mp3 file, or a folder of sound files. When a folder is used, the sound shown in the panel list plays (or a random one when nothing is picked).
contacts.label: Contacts

contact_order.description: Order contacts appear in the panel list. Change it by dragging entries in the panel.
contact_order.label: List order

folder_sounds.description: Map of names to the selected sound filename inside a folder entry. Empty means any sound (random).
folder_sounds.label: Selected folder sound

glyph.description: Icon shown in the bar for this widget.
glyph.label: Icon

match_case_sensitive.description: When off, the name is searched ignoring capitalization.
match_case_sensitive.label: Case sensitive matching

only_apps.description: Optional list of notification app names to restrict matching to. Leave empty to match notifications from any app.
only_apps.label: Only these apps

show_sound_name.description: When off, the sound name capsule below each contact name is hidden.
show_sound_name.label: Show sound name

show_widget.description: When off, the bell icon is hidden from the bar.
show_widget.label: Show bar icon

sound_folders.description: Registry of known sound-folder paths offered when adding a new entry.
sound_folders.label: Known sound folders

widget.tooltip_empty: Contact Sounds: no contacts configured. Click to open the panel.
widget.tooltip_ok: Contact Sounds: %d contact(s) configured. Click to test them.
